title: Joseph Forgives His Brothers
reflectionQuestion: What do you think Joseph felt when he saw his brothers again, after so many years away?
kidSafetyNotes: Backstory softened (brothers 'jealous, sent him far away'; pit + slavery OMITTED); no violence. KEY THEOLOGY (Adam 2026-06-15, see feedback_kid_god_with_not_cause): 'God was still working for good' NOT 'God turned it into something good' -- God WITH Joseph in the sad thing, never the cause of it. A literal 5-year-old must not hear 'God made Joseph sad on purpose.' Not-alone spine ('God never once left his side'). One image: Joseph weeping as he embraces the brothers who wronged him. Adam: A+.
